description: This Java class represents an immutable implementation of SearchResult, providing methods to create, manipulate, and serialize search result data including items, pagination offset, and cursor.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchResult
classes.description: An immutable class implementing SearchResult that holds search items, and pagination info, with serialization and factory methods.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty SearchResult instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSearchResult with provided items, next page offset, and cursor.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates SearchResult from a JSON object, parsing the contained data accordingly.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the list of search result items.

methods.name: getNextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the offset for the next page, if available.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cursor string, if available.

methods.name: hasNextPage
methods.description: Indicates whether there is a next page based on cursor or offset.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the search result.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the search result contains no items.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of the JSON values in items.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the JSON values in items.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the search result into a JSON object with versioning and optional fields.
